Day 121: Welcome to chapter six

This chapter is not about doubting your progress. It is about making sure you are ready for the genuinely hard days life still has in store, because prepared quitters do not become surprised relapsers.
Why this chapter exists
Even strong long term quitters face serious tests: grief, major stress, tough seasons. Preparing in advance dramatically lowers the risk of a slip when they arrive.

Day 123: Grief and major stress
Loss and grief are among the highest risk situations for relapse, even years into a quit, because the urge to cope the old way returns during intense pain.
Know the grief risk

Major emotional events are linked to relapse even after long smoke free periods. A cigarette during grief would not soften the pain; it would add an addiction on top of it. Planning for this now is an act of kindness to your future self.
